cancel.comment: Dialog dismiss button — cancels the action and closes the dialog.

ok.comment: Generic confirm button on an informational result dialog (acknowledge / dismiss); iOS reuses it for the custom-theme cap-reached alert.

delete.comment: Generic delete action label / a11y description (custom-theme card menu item, dictionary row delete). Also the Android media-input backspace a11y description (keyboard.deleteIcon merged 2026-09-20).

save.comment: Generic Save button: custom-dictionary add/edit entry dialog (all platforms), theme editor / name dialog (mobile). Merged 2026-09-20 from dictionary.save (儉起來) / theme.editorSave (儲存) — 儲存 matches system UI.

settings.comment: Generic Settings label: main-app bottom-nav tab title + page title (mobile), smartbar settings button a11y label (extension). Merged 2026-09-20 from keyboard.settings / nav.tabSettings. The desktop menu row is desktop.menuSettings (TaigiKeyboard Settings) since 2026-09-25 — one menu on three desktops.

pagePrevious.comment: Previous page of candidates: mobile candidate-overlay page-up a11y label, desktop shortcut row + user-data list pager. Merged 2026-09-20 from keyboard.pageUp / desktop.actionPageBackward.

pageNext.comment: Next page of candidates: mobile candidate-overlay page-down a11y label, desktop shortcut row + user-data list pager. Merged 2026-09-20 from keyboard.pageDown / desktop.actionPageForward.

error.comment: Generic error alert title (iOS backup/restore + import/export failure alerts; the alert body is localized separately). iOS-only: the Android failure surfaces are toasts that already use their own i18n keys.

info.comment: Info / help button a11y contentDescription (settings inline info-popover trigger). Android-only: iOS uses an empty-title alert whose body carries the text.

close.comment: Generic Close: Android color-picker dismiss a11y description, setup-guide full-screen close button (mobile), File menu ⌘W item (macOS). Merged 2026-09-20 from home.setupGuideCloseButton / desktop.menuClose; 關起來 → 關閉 to match them.

other.comment: Generic Other: home section header above the FAQ / other list (mobile), Shortcuts pane third block's header — the switches and the windows a key raises (desktop). Merged 2026-09-20 from home.faq / desktop.shortcutSectionOther.

edit.comment: Generic Edit: custom-theme card action-menu item (mobile), menu-bar Edit menu title (macOS). Merged 2026-09-20 from theme.cardMenuEdit / desktop.menuEdit.

toggleTranslateSwapped.comment: Flip which script is committed / shown first: desktop shortcut-recorder row (切換 rather than 輸出, USER 2026-09-10), mobile candidate-overlay display-swap button a11y label. Merged 2026-09-20 from desktop.shortcutToggleTranslateSwapped / keyboard.translateToggle.

values.ja: 漢字／ローマ字を切り替える

back.comment: Back-navigation a11y contentDescription for the TopAppBar navigationIcon on Android host sub-screens. Android-only: iOS uses the system NavigationStack back button (OS-locale, not overridable to the in-app picker). Custom in-app nav controls — including the main-app tab titles (i18n_nav_tab*) — follow the display-language picker; only the OS-provided system back affordance stays on the OS locale.

viewWebsite.comment: Link button opening an official website in the browser (data sources + the app's own site).

exportFailed.comment: Error message shown when exporting user dictionary data fails.

importFailed.comment: Error message shown when importing user dictionary data fails (incl. unreadable / non-UTF-8 file on both platforms).
